name: Score financial news sentiment (Loughran-McDonald lexicon scorer)

scenarios.name: Happy path — articles get polarity and confidence

steps.text: I run "algo-score --scorer lm --source gdelt --month 2020-01"
each article has polarity in [-1,1] and confidence in [0,1]
minute buckets aggregate net polarity and article count
the output records the model_version

scenarios.name: Empty batch abstains, does not crash

steps.text: a minute bucket with no articles
scoring runs
that bucket has n_articles 0
it is treated as ABSTAIN downstream, not an error
a fixed seed and a fixed model_version
I score the same articles twice with "lm"
the polarity and confidence are identical both times
an article already scored at the current model_version
I re-run scoring with "lm"
the cached score is used
no new inference is performed for that article
articles scored at model_version v1
I score at model_version v2 with "lm"
they are re-scored
no partition mixes v1 and v2 scores
an article whose text is not English
scoring runs
it abstains rather than producing a spurious polarity
a headline mentioning two currencies with opposite tone
scoring runs
the article is marked ambiguous (low confidence), not forced to a side

scenarios.name: LM output is stored separately, ready for future FinBERT comparison

steps.text: I run "algo-score --scorer lm --source gdelt --month 2020-01"
a transparent dictionary polarity is produced
it is stored under scorer=lm

scenarios.name: An article's minute has no matching price bar

steps.text: an article scored with polarity and confidence
its minute bucket has no corresponding price bar
features are aligned to price minutes
that bucket is excluded from the price-aligned output
it is not treated as an error

background.text: news articles with id, text, and UTC publish_ts
